title: When will Wi-Fi maintenance take place?

messages.content: When will Wi-Fi maintenance take place?

Based on verified PIT Jaunpur campus records:

• **Emergency Wi-Fi Maintenance** (Academics & Campus):
  Scheduled Wi-Fi maintenance will take place on Saturday at 2:00 PM for 15 minutes in Block B. High-speed 1Gbps connection will resume at 2:15 PM.... [Source: Emergency Wi-Fi Maintenance]

• **Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Library Hours** (Academics & Campus):
  # Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Central Library ## Campus Wi-Fi Access - **SSID 1:** `PIT-Student-Secure` — Connect using your student portal admission roll number and student portal password. - **SSID 2:** `PIT-Campus-Guest` — Available during hackathons and con... [Source: Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Library Hours]

• **Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Library Hours** (Academics & Campus):
  ## Central Library - **Location:** Central Block, Floors 1 & 2. - **Timings:** Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (extended to 10:00 PM during exam weeks and hackathons). - **Facilities:** Digital Reference Section with 60 workstations, private gr... [Source: Campus Facilities, Wi-Fi & Library Hours]

*(Note: Grounded via local retrieval. For live neural Gemma 4 inference, add a free GEMINI_API_KEY from Google AI Studio in .env.local)*
